data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old High German word 'frôh' meaning joy, Frohne is a name that embodies happiness and delight. In Christian tradition, it is also believed to symbolize the joy and contentment found in a close relationship with God. The name Frohne carries the meaning “Joy, Happiness” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Frohne usually hope their child will grow to embody joy, happiness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
